system.description:
You learn to inscribe blessings on scraps of paper, enhancing certain aspects of the body at the cost of others.

Over the course of 1 minute you can inscribe a blessing and fill it with your spiritual power. As an Action, you can affix it to a creature.

The creature gains the benefit of the blessing as long as the paper remains attached and intact — normally, no more than 1 day, as the fragile paper eventually wears free.

Unlike most abilities, you may affect a creature with multiple blessings at once.

For blessings, you may choose from one of the following:

  • Alertness

    • You gain +1 bonus to all Perception and Reflexes checks.

    • Your Initiative increases by +2.

    • You suffer a -2 dice penalty to all Willpower checks.

  • Sleepless

    • You are immune to Sleep and cannot lose consciousness by any means short of death.

    • You can take a Long Rest without falling asleep.

    • You suffer a -1 dice penalty to all Willpower checks for each day you go without sleep.

  • Sobriety

    • You do not feel the minor side-effects of intoxicating substances, including nausea, dizziness, or hangovers.

    • Your body still experiences any distress caused by said substances.

  • Strength

    • You gain +1 bonus to all Athletics and Melee Weapons checks.

    • You suffer a -1 dice penalty to Resilience checks.
